title: Loans
description: Loans you owe, tracked by hand — pick an account to have its balance follow when you receive the loan and pay each instalment, or don't record in an account for a loan that predates the app
closeConfirmBody: The instalment history stays. The loan can no longer be changed.
emptyBody: Add your first loan to track its outstanding principal.
accountHelper: Which account did the loan money arrive in? Its balance updates to match, from the start date.
paymentPrincipalNote: Principal = Total − Interest, calculated for you.
paymentDeleteConfirmLinked: Both transactions recorded in the account (principal and interest) are removed too and the account balance updates. The principal outstanding is recalculated and "Next due" steps back one period.
paymentDeleteConfirmPlain: The payment is removed from the history. The principal outstanding is recalculated and "Next due" steps back one period.
paymentEditLinkedNote: Both transactions recorded in the account are updated to match.
linkDescription: Records the loan money you received in the account you choose, so the account balance matches what really happened.
linkIncludePayments: {count, plural, one {Also record the # existing payment} other {Also record the # existing payments}}
linkIncludePaymentsHelper: Each payment is recorded on its own date, principal and interest as two transactions. Payments already recorded in an account are left as they are.
linkNoAccounts: You have no active {currency} account yet — add one first.
